rules.alternatives: No CE beyond what is required to maintain the professional (national) certification. APRNs with prescriptive authority (RXN) must document ongoing CE in pharmacology and safe prescribing in their Articulated Plan (no hour count set).
rules.legal_basis: 3 CCR 716-1, Rule 1.15 (Articulated Plan; renewal of prescriptive authority)
rules.notes: Board FAQ: no additional CE for APRNs other than maintaining professional certification. RN, APN and RXN licenses in the current cycle expire 9/30/26 (renewal accepted through 11/30/26). Prescriptive authority renews with the RN license.
